reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 12.3 affirmatively records that Customer has made no no-hire (or non-compete/exclusivity) commitment and is free to hire anyone responding to general recruitment, which matches the preferred position of no non-solicit binding Customer.
No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraph.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are artefacts of the presence heuristics — they presuppose an existing non-solicit obligation, and none binds Customer, so they do not undercut the classification.
The clause operates in our favour, so flagging it as a deviation would be over-flagging; retaining it as internal compliance evidence is appropriate.
